findings.evidence: ParityOdd.lean:201-213 — the proof consumes only `hP.e₁_orthogonal_q`, `hP.e₁_orthogonal_pT`, `hP.e₁_self_ne_zero`, `hP.e₂_orthogonal_q`, `hP.e₂_orthogonal_pT`, `hP.e₂_self_ne_zero`, `hP.e₁_orthogonal_e₂`; `hP.span` appears nowhere. Contrast ParityOdd.lean:284-285, where `eq_of_apply_e₁_e₂_eq` genuinely needs it. Roadmap convention 6 names this trap: "forcing every statement about `F₃` to carry a four-dimensionality hypothesis that only one theorem actually needs" (InclusiveStructureFunctions/README.md:138-139).
findings.fix: State it over the pair: `(e₁ e₂ : V)` with `g K.q e₁ = 0`, `g K.q e₂ = 0`, `g (pTransverse g K) e₁ = 0`, `g (pTransverse g K) e₂ = 0`, `g e₁ e₂ = 0`, `g e₁ e₁ ≠ 0`, `g e₂ e₂ ≠ 0` (or split those seven fields into a sub-structure that `SpectatorPlane` extends with `span`), and have the `SpectatorPlane` callers pass `hP.e₁_orthogonal_q` etc.
findings.issue: `apply_eq_mul_apply_e₁_e₂` takes the whole `SpectatorPlane`, but its proof never uses `hP.span` — the field that forces `V = span{p_T, q, e₁, e₂}`. Only the six orthogonality/non-nullity fields feed `exists_halfTurn`; the identity holds for any orthogonal non-null spectator pair in any dimension.

findings.evidence: ParityOdd.lean:496-499 (`⟨v 0, v 3, ![0, v 1, v 2, 0], by simp, by simp, by ext i; fin_cases i <;> simp⟩`) versus ParityOdd.lean:186 (`span : ∀ v, ∃ a b c₁ c₂, v = a • pTransverse g K + b • K.q + c₁ • e₁ + c₂ • e₂`) together with ParityOdd.lean:172-178; the derivation needs only `map_add`/`map_smul`, not `hSymm` and not the witness coordinates. Used once, at ParityOdd.lean:518.
findings.fix: Add `SpectatorPlane.exists_spectator_decomposition (hP : SpectatorPlane g K) (v : V) : ∃ (a b : ℝ) (u : V), g K.q u = 0 ∧ g (pTransverse g K) u = 0 ∧ v = a • pTransverse g K + b • K.q + u` from `hP.span`, delete `gFour_kFour_span`, and pass `spectatorPlaneFour.exists_spectator_decomposition` in `not_isLorentzCovariant_aFour`. This also gives every `SpectatorPlane` user the `hspan` input of `apply_pTransverse_eq_zero`/`apply_p_eq_zero`.
findings.issue: `Witness.gFour_kFour_span` proves the `SpectatorAssumptions.span`-shaped decomposition by hand on `ℝ⁴`, but it is a consequence of any `SpectatorPlane`: take `u := c₁ • e₁ + c₂ • e₂`, whose orthogonality to `q` and `p_T` is linearity plus the four `e_i_orthogonal_*` fields. The general lemma is missing, so the special case is proved instead.

summary: The prior findings are fixed. Two remaining level issues: the single-component lemma still carries the four-dimensionality field it never uses, and the witness re-proves by hand a spanning fact that follows from any `SpectatorPlane`.
